_comment: Reviewed Bandit findings that the gate accepts. Each entry is bound to file + test id + SHA-256 of the whitespace-normalised flagged statement (see run_bandit_allowlisted.py): moving code keeps the entry valid, changing the statement invalidates it. Add an entry only after a review that names why no untrusted input can reach the SQL; never by copying --candidates output unread. Migrated from the line-number list in WP-A.

entries.reason: Write probe on a scratch in-memory DB: `table` is a key of the module constant _WRITE_PROBES, column names are keys of the constant probe dicts (_PORTAL_BASE and fixed probes); all values bound with ?. Introduced by eb17f05 (strict backup fingerprint). Reviewed WP-A.

entries.statement: f"SELECT 1 FROM patients WHERE id = ? AND {cond}", [patient_id, *params]
entries.reason: Condition `cond` comes from policy.patient_scope_filter(): fixed SQL fragments with ? placeholders chosen by role; all values (ids, department ids) are bound through `params`. No user text reaches the SQL. Same can_read_patient query reviewed in SEC-2026-004 (was policy.py:115; moved to :126 by the WP2.4-D ACTIVE_PATIENT_SQL change). Reviewed WP-A.
`other` is the complementary literal table name (department_heads / user_departments); user_id bound. SEC-2026-004, re-reviewed WP-A.
`table` is one of two literal table names chosen by a ternary on role_id (department_heads / user_departments); user_id bound. SEC-2026-004, re-reviewed WP-A.

entries.statement: "SELECT id, name, age, phone, policy_number, diagnosis, nosology FROM patients " f"WHERE {policy.ACTIVE_PATIENT_SQL}").fetchall()
entries.reason: Only interpolation is the constant policy.ACTIVE_PATIENT_SQL (erroneous-card exclusion); no parameters, no user input. WP2.4-D; reviewed WP-A.

entries.statement: count = conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients WHERE {policy.ACTIVE_PATIENT_SQL}").fetchone()[0]
entries.reason: policy.ACTIVE_PATIENT_SQL is a module-level string constant (erroneous-card exclusion subquery) with no parameters or user input. WP2.4-D; reviewed WP-A.

entries.statement: f"""SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM notifications JOIN patients ON patients.id = notifications.patient_id WHERE {cond} AND notifications.status = 'pending' AND notifications.scheduled_at >= ? AND notifications.scheduled_at < ?""",
entries.reason: WP-E: условие области cond строит policy.patient_scope_filter из серверной модели прав; id пользователя, отделения и UTC-границы дня Москвы передаются только параметрами SQLite. Строки даты и пользовательский ввод не интерполируются в SQL. Пересмотрен измененный диапазон scheduled_at, B608 остается включенным.
